name: How much does a catastrophic injury lawyer cost?
description: Catastrophic injury lawyers typically work on a contingency fee basis, meaning they only get paid a percentage of your settlement if you win.

mainEntity.name: How much does a catastrophic injury lawyer cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: Most catastrophic injury lawyers work on a contingency fee basis. This means you do not pay any upfront legal fees. Instead, the lawyer's fees are a percentage of the compensation you receive if your case is successful. If you don't win, you typically owe no attorney fees. This arrangement allows individuals to pursue justice without immediate financial burden.
